An '''unidentified sentry droid''' model was used to monitor the status of [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] on [[Bogan]] to see that if they find balance and to inform the Je'daii if the prisoners would try to escape. The droid was [[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like, having six legs to walk around and it was not armed.
